steps.now: 兔儿爷 says the next spirit hides in one of Beijing's temples. (This chapter is still being written — the story goes on to 三里屯 for now.)
steps.past: Heard that a spirit hides among Beijing's temples — a chapter still to come.

facts.zh: 白云观有三个小石猴，要找一找。
facts.en: Three little stone monkeys are hidden around the temple — you have to look for them.

facts.zh: 桥下有一个大钱，大家往里面打钱。
facts.en: Under the bridge hangs a big wooden coin; people throw coins to ring its bell.

facts.zh: 东岳庙很老，一三一九年就有了。
这里有七十多个“司”，每个司管一件事。
facts.en: Its galleries hold more than seventy 'departments' of the afterlife, each with its own job.
